reason: The primary text studies how looped Transformers route different computations across recurrent steps using synthetic graph/parity/rule tasks, interventions, and small frozen per-token maps. It analyzes recurrent computation and steering rather than offering an inference-speed or memory reduction; deployment safety is not evaluated. Weak adjacency to looped-model lineage merits borderline.
title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does
